artifactReference.description: Digest-pinned reference to the deployable artifact. Content is opaque to the RP, which records the reference as metadata and never dereferences it. Tag-only or version-only references are rejected.

images.description: Container-image digests the artifact references, declared by the orchestrator at publish. Metadata only - the RP validates digest-pinning and never pulls, copies, or otherwise dereferences them. Empty when the artifact references no container image.

provenance.description: Source metadata describing where this revision came from.

RevisionProvenance.description: Source metadata describing where a revision came from. Creation time and identity are not repeated here - they are carried by the resource's standard ARM systemData envelope.

source.description: The orchestrator or automation that published this revision.

commitHash.description: Source commit hash the artifact was built from.

duplicateOfRevisionName.description: Name of the earliest existing revision under the same component carrying the same artifact digest. Set by the RP when a revision is created under a new name with an already-seen digest, so retention automation and dashboards can collapse duplicates.

RevisionStatus.description: The referential state of a revision.

referenced.description: True when this revision is referenced by the deployment resource of at least one environment under the namespace. The RP updates this flag as deployment references change, so it is eventually consistent and a read taken immediately after a deployment write may briefly lag. Deletion guards do not rely on it: a referenced revision cannot be deleted because references are evaluated live at delete time. Cross-environment breadth is answered by Azure Resource Graph over the deployment resources rather than by this field.
